correctness.rationale: The weight identity 2m−z+e, one empty vertex at most per rung, and twisted boundary rail constrain minimum zero patterns. With z=m and e=0 all singleton colors are 3-periodic; the cyclic twist admits this only for m≡3 mod6, giving 12 functions. At weight m+1 an even m has a unique nonempty rung, forcing other colors along the rail and both exceptional labels. For m≡5 mod6, the no-empty-rung option produces incompatible required colors; the unique surplus color produces 12m possibilities. Independently enumerated all labeled valid minima for m=3,4,5,6: 12,48,60,72. Excluded m≡1 mod6 is not covered.
residual_risks: Finite verifier checks m≤6 only; universal classification uses structural proof.
